_about: The forecast's inputs. Both the Model page (model/model.js) and code/forecast_curve.py read this file; edit here only. Probabilities are 0-1. low_case/high_case mean a lower/higher chance that he has left, so for the two timing inputs the low case is the slower one.

P_LIGHT.note: something improper beyond the affair happened and comes to light

P_OUT_IF_LIGHT.note: he leaves, given it comes to light

P_OUT_IF_NOT.note: he leaves over this anyway, given nothing more comes to light

MEDIAN_DAYS.note: median days from as_of to the decisive finding or report; low and high cases are placeholders

LAG_DAYS.note: days from then until he has actually left; all three are placeholders

ORDINARY.note: chance per year he leaves for any reason unrelated to the scandal
